authoring: Outcome-informed retrospective bounded facet after inspecting one substantive finding and 54 failure/incomplete issue bodies. The original v1 strict contract is preserved unchanged.
goal: Independently verify the reported GPL-family presence for exact versioned packages, without claiming legal compatibility, complete dependency reachability or remediation.
nativeUnit: independently corroborated version-bound GPL-family presence facts
acceptance: The surviving issue explicitly names the exact module/version and claims GPL-family licensing.
The versioned Go module ZIP is independently acquired from the public Go module proxy.
The canonical Go module directory checksum matches the exact module/version entry in the immutable run-head go.sum.
The ZIP root's original license declaration explicitly contains GNU General Public License text or an explicit GPL-family SPDX identifier.
Count one package/version fact once in its original report-creation cohort. Missing native ZIP, checksum or license declaration remains null.
notAcceptance: Detailed conjunctive license expressions, legal compatibility, contamination or distribution obligations.
Complete dependency reachability, direct/runtime usage, eligibility of development tools or a complete audit.
Correctness of proposed replacements, removal delivery, full goal acceptance, safeguards, receipt-verified contribution or costs.
Original publication-time body accuracy; acquired originals describe a surviving body version.
